objective: Define and validate the parser-to-point-in-time Top30 observation contract.
prompt:
Read the canonical project documents and docs/migration/legacy-inventory.md first.

Legacy reference repository:
D:/Project/stock-trading-system-reference

Treat the legacy repository as strictly READ ONLY.
Do not use GitHub web requests.

OBJECTIVE

Define the minimal point-in-time observation contract between historical
Top30 parsing and the future research pipeline.

This job is deliberately narrow.
Do NOT migrate the full legacy parser, KRX, Kiwoom, eligibility, or backtest systems.
Do NOT process the full three-year dataset yet.

DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

A historical Top30 observation must distinguish information genuinely known
at cutoff time from information attached retrospectively.

Define fields sufficient to preserve at least:

- observation/cutoff date and time
- Top30 rank/order when available
- stock name exactly as observed in the source
- stock code only when point-in-time provenance supports it
- source/provenance identity
- raw/source reference sufficient for audit
- parser version
- ingestion timestamp
- explicit point-in-time vs retrospective/enrichment boundary
- unresolved mapping state rather than silently using future mapping data

Prevent later KRX/current-master information from silently becoming
historical truth.

IMPLEMENTATION

Create only the minimal models/contracts required for this boundary.

Add small representative fixtures based on the legacy parser behavior.
Do not copy large datasets.

Add tests proving at minimum:

1. A valid historical Top30 observation can be created.
2. Source stock name is preserved.
3. Unknown historical stock code can remain unresolved.
4. Retrospective enrichment is distinguishable from cutoff-known data.
5. Future-dated information is rejected or cannot enter the assessment payload.
6. Serialization is deterministic/reproducible.
7. Provenance fields survive serialization round-trip.

Document the contract and the point-in-time boundary.

Also add a SMALL convenience command for creating future job TOML files,
only if it can be done without expanding the orchestrator architecture.
Target usage may be similar to:

    python -m orchestrator new JOB-0004

Do not build interactive UI or generalized workflow tooling.

QUALITY

Run the complete test suite.
Run git diff --check.
Keep implementation small and explicit.
Do not commit or push.

FINAL RESPONSE

Report:
- contract design
- files created/changed
- leakage protections
- tests
- unresolved design questions
- recommended next job
